opening.argument: The presentation makes purchasing one of five product packages the entry point to earning, then ties compensation to the sales team that participants build. It promises 10% of business volume from that team and displays matching bonuses reaching four generations and 25%, making recruitment and tier placement central to the proposed earnings. The speaker reinforces that structure by urging viewers to “join today and start building your team.” It also promotes token splits as a way to obtain “four times your money,” while claiming that as more members join, demand and the token’s price grow. This is a solicitation to purchase, recruit, and participate in a compensation structure—not instruction in a trading method or reporting about someone else’s offer.
